cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/nrvcomp.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ucl/ucl.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){ if(argc<3)return 2; FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET); unsigned char*in=malloc(n); fread(in,1,n,f); fclose(f); unsigned outlen=n+n/8+1024; unsigned char*out=malloc(outlen); if(ucl_init()!=UCL_E_OK)return 3; ucl_uint dst_len=outlen; int r=ucl_nrv2b_99_compress(in,n,out,&dst_len,NULL,10,NULL,NULL); if(r!=UCL_E_OK){fprintf(stderr,"r=%d\n",r);return 4;} f=fopen(argv[2],"wb"); fwrite(out,1,dst_len,f); fclose(f); fprintf(stderr,"%ld -> %u\n",n,(unsigned)dst_len); return 0;}
EOF
